title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Abolishing Certain Judicial Interpretations Jointly Issued before the End of 1993
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate

Notice on Abolishing Certain Judicial Interpretations Jointly Issued Before the End of 1993

Fa Fa [1994] No. 21

Gao Jian Hui [1994] No. 37

To the High People's Courts and People's Procuratorates of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Courts and Military Procuratorates of the People's Liberation Army:

Starting from 1993, the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate jointly conducted a comprehensive review of judicial interpretations jointly issued by the two institutions from 1979 to 1993. We hereby print and distribute to you the first batch of the catalogue of judicial interpretations to be abolished, as discussed and approved by the Judicial Committee of the Supreme People's Court and the Procuratorial Committee of the Supreme People's Procuratorate. These four judicial interpretations to be abolished shall no longer apply from the date of issuance of this Notice (some had already become invalid on their own). Judgments and rulings made prior to this date applying the above judicial interpretations to relevant cases shall not be altered. The work of reviewing judicial interpretations is still ongoing. We will notify you in subsequent batches of jointly issued judicial interpretations that should be abolished. Some judicial interpretations contain only certain provisions that are no longer suitable for current judicial practice. We will study and amend them based on a comprehensive review. If you have any opinions, please report them to us promptly.

Appendix: Catalogue of Judicial Interpretations Jointly Issued by the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate before the End of 1993 to Be Abolished (First Batch)

August 29, 1994
